comment: The tolerance control is a latching lamp button configured with three values, so each click steps to the next of 1ms, 16ms and 64ms and then wraps. src/CLatch.cpp:65 queues a falling change whenever an input reads zero and has not moved, which is the state of an unpatched jack, so empty rows are driven low rather than left alone. Rises and falls are detected by comparing one sample against the previous one, with no threshold.
